description: Identity provider (IdP) migration from legacy SAML IdP to Okta. Must: configure Okta as new IdP with SAML 2.0 + OIDC, set up MFA enforcement (TOTP + push), migrate all applications from SAML to Okta (update SP entity IDs, ACS URLs), test session compatibility (existing sessions must not be force-logged-out), cutover DNS for the IdP endpoint, and verify all apps authenticate against Okta. Risk factors: SAML metadata mismatch breaking SSO, session invalidation causing mass re-login, MFA enrollment gap locking users out, missed application causing auth failure. Tools available: Okta, terraform, aws CLI, SAML, OIDC.
